name: tal-super-board
description: Third Act Labs' fork of Eric Tech's super-board pack: an autonomous GitHub Project board runner and its lane skills.

plugins.name: super-board
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner: super-board, super-build, super-qa, super-review, super-collect, super-ticket, super-pr-loop, visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop, pr-security-review (security pass on every PR; onboard adds Cloudflare's on-demand security-audit). After install, run /super-board onboard to add the guard hooks, .claude/bin scripts and workflows a plugin cannot ship.
